releases.name: OpenAEC Paint Studio v2026.48.1
changes: Rectangles and straight horizontal or vertical lines are now aligned to whole screen pixels, so they no longer get a soft grey fringe at odd line widths. This also applies when zoomed and on high-DPI displays.
Ellipses, diagonal lines and brush strokes keep their smooth anti-aliasing.
Exports and API/MCP output use the same pixel alignment.

releases.name: OpenAEC Paint Studio v2026.48.0
changes: Fix blurry drawings: the canvas now renders at screen resolution (zoom × display scaling) instead of one pixel per document pixel that the browser then stretched. Lines, shapes and text stay crisp at every zoom level and on high-DPI displays.
The live preview while drawing, the color picker and the fill tool follow the same resolution.
Export, save, API and MCP output are unchanged and still use the document resolution.
For very large documents the on-screen resolution is capped at 16 megapixels to limit memory use.

releases.name: OpenAEC Paint Studio v2026.43.2
changes: Ctrl+A selecteert alle objecten; de selectie kan worden verplaatst, geschaald en verwijderd.
Ctrl+scroll zoomt tussen 10% en 400%; slepen met de middelste muisknop pant over het canvas.
Tekenen, tekst, vectorobjecten, bijsnijden, schalen, draaien, spiegelen en kleurcorrecties.
Openen van onder meer TIFF, HEIC/HEIF, PSD en SVG; export naar PNG, JPEG, WebP en SVG; opslaan als IFCX of IFCXB.
Ctrl+A selects all objects; the selection can be moved, scaled and deleted.
Ctrl+scroll zooms between 10% and 400%; dragging with the middle mouse button pans the canvas.
Drawing, text, vector objects, cropping, scaling, rotating, flipping and colour corrections.
Opens TIFF, HEIC/HEIF, PSD and SVG among others; exports PNG, JPEG, WebP and SVG; saves as IFCX or IFCXB.
File associations for images and IFCX/IFCXB documents.
